description: Weekly United States COVID-19 Hospitalization Metrics by County – ARCHIVED is published by CDC Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP) Surveillance Branch, National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). The archive reports county-level COVID-19 hospitalisation measures from hospital submissions. Its stated coverage is United States; weekly county aggregates through May 2024. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain U.S. Government. Updates ended in May 2024; the final reporting weeks include incomplete submissions. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
